message.content:
Looking at panels e, f, and g, the arrowheads (cell somas) appear in two distinct positions relative to the layer brackets on the right: some lie within the outer nuclear layer (ONL) and some within the inner nuclear layer (INL). This reflects the migration of the Müller‑glia‑derived rod somas from the INL toward the ONL during the initial and intermediate stages. Therefore the somas reside in both the INL and the ONL.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
